text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Exhausted from the events at the temple,
Yui and {0} make their way back to the guildhouse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
神殿での出来事の後、ユイと{0}は
疲れを感じながらギルドハウスに戻った。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: We're back.
text_block_list.orig_text: ただいまー……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I'm so exhausted.
Waving through that sea of people didn't help, either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人混みの中を歩いてきたのもあるけど……
すっごく疲れちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: H-huh? What's with that weird light?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ？　
なんか部屋の中に光があるよ？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Wait. I'm getting deja vu.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにこれ……
見覚えがあるような……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right.
Whenever this light appears, I just... feel so sleepy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
この光を見ると……
どうしてなのか、
いつも、
眠く……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
{0}? Hello!
And happy new year,while I'm at it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　{0}クン？　こんにちは。
明けましておめでとう。
今年もよろしくね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I take it you're out shopping as well?
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}クンもお買い物？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Do I have something on my face?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうしたの？　
わたし、
どこか変かな？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Oh. Is it the kimono?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
もしかして着物にびっくりした？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
You might have noticed, but it's the same design
as the one I have in Astrum. There's a feature that lets you
scan in kimonos from outside the game, so I used that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この着物、
アストルムの衣装と同じ柄なんだよ。
リアルの着物をスキャンできる機能があるから、
それを使ったの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. Now you've got me all flustered...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
なんでだろう、
照れちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?!
Th-thanks...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？　
あ、
ありがとう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I honestly didn't expect that.
You really caught me off guard!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな風に言われると思ってなかったから、
びっくりしちゃった！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
I can't imagine this being a bad year if it's
already off to this good of a start.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
新年から{0}クンに褒められるなんて、
今年もすごく良い年になりそう！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Oh. Sorry, looks like my brothers need something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ごめんね、
弟たちから電話が……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: You [[lost]] it?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なくしちゃった！？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Wh-what now? Errr, uhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしようって……
えっと、
えっと……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: They lost the bag that had their new year's pocket money in it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
弟たちが、
お年玉の入った袋をどこかで落としちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Where are you right now?
Okay. I'll be there right away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今どこにいるの？　
……分かった。
すぐそっちに行くから。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: What's this...?
text_block_list.orig_text: これって……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
No way! This is your own pocket money, isn't it?!
I can't accept that! Please take it back!
choice_data_list: I'd hate to leave them feeling terrible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
これ、
{0}クンのお年玉だよね！？
ダメだよこんなの！　
受け取れないよ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
And I appreciate that!
But this is yours! I can't just take it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも！
だからって、
こんなことしてもらうわけには……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...But you won't listen, will you?
You're beyond stubborn once you've decided to help someone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……{0}クンは、
一度誰かを助けるって決めたら、
絶対最後まで引かないよね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*
Thanks! I swear I'll make it up to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
ありがとう！　
今度必ずお礼するね！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I need to go meet up with them, so I'll see you later!
And again, thank you so much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあわたし、
弟たちのところへ行くね！
本当にありがとう！　
またね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With Yui gone, {0} makes
his way to his local anime store to partake in the new year's sales.
text_block_list.orig_text:
優衣と別れた{0}は、
初売りで賑わうアニメショップへ向かった。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Once there, he notices a small paper bag.
choice_data_list: Deliver it to the store clerk.
text_block_list.orig_text: すると階段の端に、小さな紙の袋が落ちているのを見つけた。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Must be someone's pocket money.
Thankfully there's a name on it.
Let's see... Kusano...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お年玉袋か……
氏名が書いてありますね。
草野……
えーっと名前は……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Hello? What's wrong?
Don't worry, they've settled down now.
We're about to go to the police station...
choice_data_list: There's an anime store you should be going to instead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしもし？　
どうしたの？　
弟たちなら心配しないで。
今はもう泣き止んでて、
とりあえず交番に行こうって……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
An anime store?
Whoa! What's gotten into you all?!Calm down!
Sorry, they went crazy the second I mentioned the store!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アニメショップ？　
あっ、
ちょっとどうしたの！？
こら、騒がないの！　
ごめんね、
弟たちが騒ぎ出しちゃって！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay! I get it! Quiet down!
Sorry, I'll phone you back later! Bye!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
分かったから静かにして！
また電話するね！　
それじゃあ！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
I take it you know who this belongs to?
Oh! Please wait!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひょっとして、
持ち主のお知り合いですか？
あっ！　
お客様！　
お待ちください！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, {0} meets Yui again
at the beginning of the new semester.
text_block_list.orig_text:
後日、新学期を迎えた{0}は、
教室で優衣と再会した。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, {0}!
Thanks so much for the other day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おはよう{0}クン！
この間はホントにありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Guess what? We ended up finding my brothers' pocket money!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのね、
弟たちのお年玉、
見つかったの！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: So, here. You can have yours back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
これ、
{0}クンのお年玉と……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Plus, uh... Um. This as well!
I figured I should pay you back, so I knit a scarf.
I'm not sure if you actually need one, but please use it if you do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あと、
えっと、
その……
お礼にと思って、
これ！　
マフラー！
手編みだけど、
もし良かったら……
使って？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: That's not all, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それと、
もう一つお礼があるんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
H-here! Take this coupon, too!
It's for my family's restaurant!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これ！　
うちのお店のサービス券！
うちね、
定食屋なの……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Don't force yourself to come though, okay?
Leave it until you really, [[really]] feel like eating out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁっ、でも
うちに来るのは、
どうしても食べたくなったらでいいから！　
ね？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... I really can't believe Mom and Dad!
Just because he helped me out doesn't mean
they need to start calling him my boyfriend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう……
お父さんもお母さんも、
助けてもらったからって、
{0}クンを「彼氏」だと思うなんて！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Even worse, they want me to bring him along!
No way, no way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかも、
顔が見たいから連れてこいって、
絶対無理〜！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I might actually die of embarrassment if they
started asking him all sorts of weird questions...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}クンのこと、
変に詮索されるの、
恥ずかしいし……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
They forced that coupon on me though, so I didn't have a choice...
But it'll be really awkward if he actually comes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
強引にサービス券持たされちゃったし、
渡すしかなかったよね……
店に来たら絶対こじれちゃうよ〜！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
N-nothing! Nothing at all!
See you later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
ななな、
なんでもないよ！
じゃあね{0}クン！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
\"See you later?\" We sit right beside each other, you big dumbo!
Literally all I did after that was sit down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……じゃあねもなにも、
席は隣同士なんだから座るだけだった！
なにやってるの、
わたしのバカぁ〜！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
He's gonna think I'm a weirdo, isn't he?
Argh! This is so embarrassing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
変なヤツって思われてないかな……？
ううう、
恥ずかしいぃよぉ～！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
And... welcome back.
I whipped up that little dream based on your old memories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
お疲れ様～
今のはあんたの記憶を元に作った、
言ってみれば夢みたいなものよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
That expression on her face when you called
out to her sure was something, huh?
Like she'd just had a fateful encounter with someone precious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}に声かけられた時のユイの顔、
まるで運命の相手に出会ったお姫様みたい。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
That'd make you the knight in shining armor, I guess?
I wouldn't be surprised if you turned up on
a brilliant white steed someday, if I'm being honest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さしずめあんたは、
ピンチのお姫様を救う騎士かしら。
いつかは白馬に乗って、
ユイの前に現れちゃうかも知れないわね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Yui needs you over there as much as she does over here.
So take good care of her, you hear?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっちでもユイには{0}が必要なんだから、
ちゃんと見ててあげなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
That said. Let's try and be a little bit selfless, okay?
Though that's probably a tall order for you, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただし、
あんたも自己犠牲はほどほどにしときなさい。
分かった？　
って言っても、
どうせあんたは頑張っちゃうのよね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: You're just that sort of person, alas.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうヤツなのよね、
あんたって人間は……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Where am I...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー……
ここは……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I fell asleep the second I got back.
I take it you did the same?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか。
帰ってきてすぐ寝ちゃったんだ……
騎士クンもそうだったの？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Hey. I had this really vivid dream there.
And well. You were in it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのね、
わたし、
夢を見てたみたい。
それでね、
夢の中で騎士クンが出てきたの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Everything about you was the same.
Kind and reliable. Just like in real life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢の中の騎士クンも、
今ここにいる騎士クンも、
全然変わらなくて、
優しくて……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It made me realize that you'll probably never change,
no matter the circumstances. And you know what?
That realization made me really happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クンはどこにいても
騎士クンなんだって思った。
そしたらね？　
なんだかすごく……
うれしくなっちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
That said.
I must have been exhausted if I fell asleep that quickly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
すぐ寝ちゃうほど疲れてたなんて思わなかったな……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Do you mind if I tag along with you after this?
You did the same for me, so it only feels right.
choice_data_list: I've got some pocket money to give out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきまではわたしの用事に付き合ってもらってたし、
今度はわたしが
騎士クンの用事に付き合うね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
For Kokkoro, right?
Well. We might as well bring some mochi
for Pecorine and Karyl, while we're at it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コッコロちゃんにだね。
じゃあせっかくだし、
ペコリーヌちゃんとキャルちゃんにも、
お餅をおすそ分けしようかな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
How much should I bring? This much seems like it'd be fine...
Huh? What's wrong? 
You don't think it'll be nearly enough? Really?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どれくらいあればいいかな……
これくらい？
どうしたの騎士クン？　
全然足りない？　
そうかな？　
ホントに？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With their preparations all done,
{0} and Yui set out
to deliver goodies to the rest of the Gourmet Guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
準備を終えたユイは{0}と共に、
コッコロにお年玉を渡しに、
ぺコリーヌとキャルにはお餅を渡しに行くのだった。
